Your Best Friend
Your companion. Your confidant. Your baby. When your pet looks at you, they see their best friend. We'll help you care for them like one.
We see a different way to build a veterinary hospital. One with an audacious idea...
Reimagining Care
Veterinary medicine must begin with empathy. It must begin with understanding what your pet means to you, understanding the relationship you share, and understanding how we can best make a difference in your life. Because everything flows from that. And every single thing we do is about making a difference in the life you share with the pet you love so much. We listen to you. We help you. We guide you. Here, we live to change lives. Now, let us change yours.
She’s there for you when things get stressful.
She’s there for you when days are long.
She’s there for you when you need a friend.
Now, we’ll help you be there for her.
Give us a call. We’ll protect her together.

A Culture Of Pioneers
Rethink everything. That’s our mantra. As the first Fear Free Practice in Minnesota, we are proud to have attracted some of the most talented veterinary professionals in the region. And we share a common belief in innovation. This culture animates everything we do. We have designed a new kind of experience for pet owners. One where your pet’s emotions are in the center of everything – which improves patient care. One where we work to understand the life you share with your pet – and guide you to an even better relationship. And one where we imagine the future of what a real partner in veterinary care can be. We do it because you love your pet so deeply. And you’re not only their hero. You’re ours, too.
A Team You Can Trust
The staff at North Shore Veterinary Hospital are the absolute best. My pup has serious anxiety and they know all the right things to do to make him feel better. He is more and more comfortable everytime we go. Dr Lisa is kind, patient, thorough and very helpful in explaining things to this anxious dog momma. So grateful for these folks!
Ashley
It seems strange to write that I had a wonderful experience with my puppy in an emergency situation. I am so grateful to Dr. Kay Boucher’s bedside manner and compassion during a medical crisis and her ongoing care and concern as we work towards better health. Dr. Kay is open to conversation about health treatment options while being straight forward with her recommendations.
Tina
Duluth has such a treasure in this vet hospital. We have had occasion to work with each of the doctors, and they are all among the most caring, compassionate, and competent vets one could hope for. We also have encountered many of the vet techs and they are outstanding. Our pets mean the world to us, and we are so grateful to have this resource to help us care for them. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.
Jessica
This post box isn’t long enough for us to say all the good things about North Shore Veterinary Hospital! Not only were they wonderful at healing our pup, they kept us calm in the process! Highly highly highly recommend!
Jesica
Happy NSVH was willing to take our new puppy in during these tough times! The staff was very friendly and happy to see him which makes the experience all the more better. Considering everything we had done the cost was reasonable and even though we’re across town we’re highly considering sticking with NSVH.
Niki
We have four cats and having the mobile vet come to our house was amazing! My girls didn’t have to leave their home and be stressed. Dr. Hargrove has a great sense of humor. His assistant (I am so sorry I don’t remember her name) engaged my girls and made them feel comfortable. None of my girls care for going to the vet, but this was possibly the best experience I have ever had with exams and shots.
I have been a client of NSV my whole adult life. This new addition of the mobile unit tells me, I’ve made the best choice for the best care for my girlies.
Thanks Dr. H. for all of your hard work and for putting animals first in your practice!
Elizabeth
